case_selection.policy: all cases from the complete frozen source receipt

cell_point_forecast.definition: arithmetic midpoint of lower and upper completed incidence

interpretation_guards: Lower and upper completions are scored separately for closures, concepts, canonical bases, and lattice covers.
No set-theoretic concept-family or closure interval is inferred from relation inclusion.
Midpoint Brier score and ECE evaluate a point forecast, not calibration of the set-valued interval.
Observed flips remain observed values in both completions; completion addresses only unknown and missing cells.
The comparator has no fitted parameters, model selection, or post-result tuning.

method_reference.authors: Fernando Chacon-Gomez, M. Eugenia Cornejo, Didier Dubois, Jesus Medina, and Henri Prade
method_reference.title: Handling incomplete information in formal concept analysis - a possibilistic approach
